title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Realm of the Gods

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff… I got closer… to my friend… So much closer…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've never been this fast before… For a moment… The view was…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If I'd run at that speed on the last stretch, I would've…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant… This… still isn't enough…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Nothing is beyond me… Even if it means abandoning everything I have, I'll push on ahead, even further…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's because she was there… Silence Suzuka…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I have to bring as much passion as she does… Next time, I'll try even harder…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa ho ho… See that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: She made it! She almost made it… She was just a step away… but she's finally done it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is yelling out as she leaps over the fence to join Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cafe, spare no details! What did you see? Far off in the distance, what was there?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The moment you reached top speed, your expression changed ever so slightly. What in the world happened?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In that moment…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I saw a light in the distance… One I'd never seen before…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A light?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's the world we live in right now… But that distant light…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It felt like something from another world. A light that… only my friend knows.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I felt that if I touched that light, everything would change. Illusions wouldn't be illusions anymore…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And I would understand everything… Even the meaning behind my birth as an Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The meaning… behind your birth as an Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Such a frontier… actually…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see now! I finally understand now, after all this time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is the result! You're finally going to reach that frontier, just as I planned!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good, this is good! This is really good! Anyone could have managed it. You, anyone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This has to be a good thing! You did it… It was you! Yes… You!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But… I see… So it was you, then. You… Only you… can go beyond!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Only you? Only… you. Just… you…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Oh. Ahhh…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: AAAAARGH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's uncharacteristic scream suddenly pierces the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Damn it, damn it, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Be happy… Be happy about it! Just be satisfied! Be SATISFIED!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Am I not happy? I'll just keep going further and set new targets!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But still… Will I never see it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's fine that it's Cafe! Anyone would've been fine! I would've been! But…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Am I the only one who can't? …Wuhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's just an urge. A yearning for something. But the tone of her voice… I feel like I've heard it before somewhere.
WUHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It felt like it came from her friend… A voice without a voice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Has it… already been decided?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Results are immutable… I suppose they can't be overruled…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, no, no no no!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If only I had this new key!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon, um…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Excuse me. I have… some matters to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I didn't plan for this… I didn't…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Agnes Tachyon leaves. Watching her walk away, I realize I've never seen her so shaken.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, about my race against Silence Suzuka today…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I feel as if it meant something. It's the same as when I ran against Special Week…
choice_data_list: You think this race, too, is… guiding you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Yes. We canceled our plans to go abroad, and yet, my friend was in front of her today…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka… There was something about running with her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What if there was some kind of fateful reason behind their race? If there was, then…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Actually, that reminds me of something T.M. Opera O said.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She just came out with it… but it's left an impression on me…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera said I was the companion of Leckermaul.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's how she described me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A companion is someone who accompanies another, isn't it? So is she talking about my…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That word implies some kind of karmic connection. But then, maybe it was said without any real thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Putting conjecture aside for now, I steer the conversation back to her friend. If she's still around, she must still want to guide Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We couldn't compete abroad, but it doesn't look like we have to give up on our dream…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running internationally… While thinking it over, an idea comes to me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So, for our next goal…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'd be competing in the Japan Cup instead of competing internationally, of course. But there's no need to point that out.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer… That'll be our France, then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights on the Japan Cup.
